name: elementor-headless
description: AI-agent skill: build and modify Elementor pages by writing the underlying JSON directly - no visual editor, no DOM. Queryable control surface of 192 widgets and 13 elements (49,857 control pairs), every Elementor Pro-only control labeled from a measured Free-vs-Pro diff, and a verification pipeline that ends at the rendered page. Installs into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Continue, Windsurf and Claude.ai.
author: moksa (https://moksaweb.com)
